identity.headline: I build full-stack products powered by AI.
identity.intro: Third-year CSBS undergraduate who builds full-stack platforms, from multi-tenant ERP to real-time ECG tools. Solved 1000+ problems across coding platforms.
identity.about: I'm a Computer Science and Business Systems student at KIT, Coimbatore, building full-stack products with React, Spring Boot, Node.js and FastAPI. My work spans ERP systems, medical telemetry and e-commerce, and I add generative AI and automation where it removes manual effort. During my internship at Learnlogicify Technologies, I built an AI-powered outreach pipeline that cut manual work by 60%. I also compete in competitive programming, with 500+ LeetCode problems and 100+ contests.

projects.title: NexOS Enterprise
projects.summary: Cloud-native, multi-tenant ERP unifying accounting, inventory, manufacturing and payroll.
projects.description: Developed a multi-tenant ERP platform unifying financial accounting, multi-location inventory, manufacturing and payroll into a real-time digital core. Integrated a responsive React 19 frontend with a modular Spring Boot backend, enforcing thread-bound row-level tenant isolation and a 36-permission RBAC matrix.

projects.title: PMcardio Advanced
projects.summary: Real-time 12-lead ECG visualization and analysis platform for physicians.
projects.description: Built a responsive full-stack medical telemetry platform that lets physicians visualize, calibrate and analyze 12-lead ECG data with persistent SQLite storage. Engineered a custom 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas rendering engine with CRT phosphor sweep simulation, dual-axis caliper tools (DX in ms, DY in mV) and gain/lead projection adjustments.

projects.title: EduManage Portal
projects.summary: Enterprise LMS & ERP portal with Gemini AI learning insights, rubric evaluation co-pilot & in-browser coding lab.
projects.description: Architected an enterprise LMS & ERP portal leveraging Next.js 16, React 19, and Prisma ORM, serving 3 role personas (Student, Teacher, Admin) across 16 relational data entities. Engineered an academic health monitoring engine utilizing Google Gemini AI and linear regression trajectory algorithms to predict at-risk students based on attendance anomalies and assignment velocities. Developed an automated rubric-grading assistant providing contextual grading drafts and actionable feedback for educators, reducing manual evaluation time. Built an interactive code execution sandbox supporting programming assignments, starter code templates, and automated test-case verification. Enforced a clean layered architecture (Controller-Service-Repository) with Zod schema validations, JWT cookie authentication, bcrypt password hashing, and Admin 2FA verification.

points: Built an end-to-end AI-powered email outreach pipeline on Make.com, integrating Perplexity AI and Google Gemini with QuickMail and Google Sheets to automate lead research, email generation and outreach sequencing.
